item.title: WakeBee 0.15.0 — one-time manual upgrade
item.description:
WakeBee has new Apple app and helper identifiers. This update needs a one-time manual installation.

Keep the lid open. In the old app, end your session, remove closed-lid setup under Settings → Closed Lid → Advanced, disable Launch at login, and quit before installing. Keep a backup until migration finishes.

Open the release page for the download and full migration instructions. Your preferences and Polar activation can migrate; helper and login approvals must be set up again.

WakeBee 0.14.0

A new name and a simpler purchase flow.

  • The app, Settings, and installer now use the WakeBee name and the existing sun icon. The menu bar stays icon-only, with an optional countdown.
  • Purchases and license activation use Polar. Existing Polar licenses and saved activations continue working with the WakeBee name.
  • License activation checks the WakeBee product, remembers this Mac’s activation for retries, and releases the device slot when you remove the license.
  • Closed-lid setup errors now show their details directly, with a Copy setup details button for troubleshooting.

Untiring 0.13.2

  • The session panel starts with Timer, Until, and Unlimited. Settings and additional options are now in the footer.
  • Closed Lid settings use clearer language, explain when a charger is required, and keep setup details and removal in expandable sections.
  • Timer fields accept numeric input and keep hours and minutes within the supported range.

Existing licenses, preferences, and closed-lid limits are unchanged.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Includes Apple silicon and Intel builds. Closed-lid behavior has not been verified on every Mac model or macOS version; check it on your Mac before relying on unattended work.

Untiring 0.13.1

  • New sun artwork for the app icon, menu-bar panel, and installer.
  • The menu bar shows the app icon and optional countdown, without the full app name.
  • The panel and installer use the Untiring.app name.

Your existing license, preferences, and session controls remain compatible.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.
